note: The engine catalogue published with the graph spec (editor spec §51, spec_engine_catalogue). An engine is certified against this catalogue. A certificate names the spec version and the catalogue version, so it cannot be read as proof against another. The reference engine is pinned here, and the pin in python/graph_spec/pyproject.toml and its lock file must match. test/graph-spec-conformance.test.js holds the three together.

certificate.rule: A certificate holds for one spec version and one catalogue version. A new version of either needs a new certificate.
